source.features: 胸背带真实胸腹环、背腹侧连接和牵引环
source.limitations: M043技术候选：连续曲面、翼、斜带及骨链，不强制整件卡格。昆虫最小细件1mm，其余5mm原生。全部非碰撞、未绑定电源零发光。骨架保留真实父子关节与刚性分件、归属和有限姿态，不冒称软皮肤、动作片段、原骨架重定向、飞行游泳/步态/生态/所有权集成。穿戴仅指定猫犬牛有限静态配合；空牌不捏造身份，人工美术验收0。

fit.meaning: Two real thorax bands with back/ventral/side connectors. Native cat or dog is retained separately; no claim of all poses, load safety or leash simulation.

source.dimensionBasis: Author anatomy/family guide or finite accessory fit, not original runtime dimensions

materialAssignmentReview.note: Rig guides use tooling purposes; insect tissue and wing scales/membranes/veins, bird plumage, and worn hardware/webbing/ink remain independently replaceable. Coarse skin/hair categories do not equate their physical tissues.
